pattern: reply ended with a numbered list of decisions for the user
experience: Agents end a finished reply with 'Still pending from you: 1. … 2. … 3. …', so the user has to type one long reply that addresses each item by number.
rule: A finished reply that leaves decisions only the user can make: declare them with t3_open_questions at the end of your turn and do not list them again in your text.
